title: Bobo Learns to Clean His Room

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Oh my! Look at all this mess!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Can you see the toys, the books, and the clothes on the floor?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Can you find the yellow duck?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Can you find the blue book?

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Where is my red ball? I want to play!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Hi, Bobo! Can we play ball?

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Whoa! Your room is so messy!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: I can't find my ball anywhere!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: I know! I'll push it all under the bed!

vo.speaker: leo
vo.text: Oh no! It's even messier now!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Can you help Bobo? What should he do?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Let's tidy up together! It's easy!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Step one. Toys go in the toy box!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Bobo picks up his toys. One, two, three!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Can you say it? Toys in the box!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Step two. Books go on the shelf!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Leo helps too. One, two, three!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Your turn! Books on the shelf!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Step three. Clothes go in the basket!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Bobo picks up his sock, his shirt, and his hat...

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: My red ball! I found it!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: When my room is tidy, I can find my things!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Your turn! Clothes in the basket!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Look! Bobo's room is clean and tidy!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: They play and play... and the room gets messy again!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Uh-oh! What do we do after we play?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Let's have a tidy-up race! Count with us!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Ten... nine... eight... seven... six... five... four... three... two... one!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: And where does a ball go?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: And why is it good to tidy up?

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: So we can find our things, and play!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Tidy up a little, every day!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Bye-bye, friends! Keep your room tidy!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Can YOU tidy up your toys today?
